+from itertools import compress, islice
+from operator import add
+
+from .base import Tokenizer, apply_merges, _count_elements
+
+
+def _update_stats(stats, old, new, pair, c, k):
+    """
+    Update pair counts (stats of old) in place so they become the stats of new.
+    Token sequences are str with one code point per token (chr(token id)) and
+    pairs are 2-char str: new = old.replace(pair, c), k = old.count(pair) and
+    c does not occur in old. Only pairs touching a merged occurrence change;
+    zero counts are removed.
+    """
+    p0, p1 = pair
+    get = stats.get
+    n_old = len(old)
+    find = new.find
+    removed = [pair]
+    rapp = removed.append
+    prev = -2
+    q = -1
+    for m in range(k):
+        q = find(c, q + 1)
+        j = q + m # position of this occurrence in old
+        if q and prev != q - 1:
+            # left neighbour is untouched (an adjacent previous occurrence
+            # already accounted for the pair between them)
+            a = new[q-1]
+            p = a + p0
+            stats[p] -= 1
+            rapp(p)
+            p = a + c
+            stats[p] = get(p, 0) + 1
+        if j + 2 < n_old:
+            p = p1 + old[j+2]
+            stats[p] -= 1
+            rapp(p)
+            p = c + new[q+1]
+            stats[p] = get(p, 0) + 1
+        prev = q
+    stats[pair] -= k
+    for p in removed:
+        if get(p) == 0:
+            del stats[p]
